newsitem.title: USA: No Medicare hospital rate freeze in budget - Shalala.
newsitem.headline: No Medicare hospital rate freeze in budget - Shalala.

text.p: Health Secretary Donna Shalala said Monday President Clinton's 1998 budget will not call for a freeze on the Medicare payment rate to hospitals.

Speaking to the American Hospital Association, Shalala said "This administration will not propose to freeze your payments." The Prospective Payment Assessment Commission, the group that reviews Medicare payments for Congress, had suggested that the hospital rate could be frozen.
An administration official said Shalala's comments did not rule out a freeze but said "We start off saying, 'This is our proposal: We do not believe a freeze is necessary.'"
